consumer.situation_summary: The user purchased an online product that was delivered damaged, and the seller refused a refund.
consumer.detected_issue: Defective Goods & Consumer Redressal under Consumer Protection Act

applicable_rights_or_schemes.topic: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 — Right to Redressal
applicable_rights_or_schemes.explanation: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019 provides consumers with rights and potential remedies, which may include repair, replacement, refund, or compensation depending on the facts and applicable law.
applicable_rights_or_schemes.relevance_reason: Directly applies to e-commerce purchases delivered in a damaged state.
applicable_rights_or_schemes.action_recommended: File a formal complaint on the National Consumer Helpline (NCH) or send a legal notice.

action_plan.immediate_action: Preserve all proof of purchase, order numbers, unboxing photos/videos, and communication history with the seller.

ordered_steps.title: Gather Evidence & Tax Invoice
ordered_steps.description: Compile invoice, delivery receipt, photos of damaged goods, and seller refusal emails.
ordered_steps.why_it_matters: Required to prove purchase and timely notification of grievance.

ordered_steps.title: Register Complaint on National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
ordered_steps.description: NCH provides a government-operated pre-litigation grievance redress mechanism that can facilitate resolution with the concerned company.
ordered_steps.why_it_matters: Pre-litigation grievance redress mechanism supported by government.

ordered_steps.title: Consider Escalation to the Appropriate Consumer Commission
ordered_steps.description: After submitting the requested evidence, if the issue remains unresolved, consider filing a formal complaint on the e-Daakhil portal with the appropriate Consumer Commission.
ordered_steps.why_it_matters: Legal escalation may compel resolution and compensation through formal adjudication.

action_plan.target_authority: National Consumer Helpline / Appropriate Consumer Commission
warnings: Do not throw away original packaging.
Keep track of 30-day return policy window.

sources.title: Rights of Consumers — Product Liability & Deficiency in Service

consumer.disclaimer: This is a civic information synthesis provided for educational purposes. Verify details on official government portals.

rti.situation_summary: User seeks information regarding public fund allocation and progress on a local municipal infrastructure project.
rti.detected_issue: Request for Information under Right to Information Act, 2005

applicable_rights_or_schemes.explanation: Citizens have the legal right to request records, expenditure details, and sanction letters from public authorities.
applicable_rights_or_schemes.relevance_reason: Applies directly to municipal works, local bodies, and government departments.
applicable_rights_or_schemes.authority: Public Information Officer (PIO), Local Municipal Corporation
applicable_rights_or_schemes.action_recommended: Submit a formal RTI Application along with the prescribed fee (Rs. 10).

action_plan.immediate_action: Identify the exact Public Authority / Department responsible for the local road/infrastructure project.

ordered_steps.title: Draft Specific RTI Questions
ordered_steps.description: Frame concise, unambiguous questions regarding tender details, budget allocated, contractor name, and completion deadline.
ordered_steps.why_it_matters: Vague questions allow public officers to delay responses.

ordered_steps.title: Submit RTI to Public Information Officer (PIO)
ordered_steps.description: Submit via RTI Online portal or registered post with Rs. 10 court fee stamp / IPO.
ordered_steps.why_it_matters: Mandates a legal response within 30 days.

warnings: Questions must ask for existing record details, not opinions or explanations.

rti.disclaimer: This RTI guide provides standard legal templates. Ensure correct PIO address before mailing.
